interface.longDescription: Explore inheritance, sequences and experiments. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Build a one-locus Punnett square; Inspect a DNA sequence; Compare experimental groups. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a one-locus Punnett square.
Help me inspect a DNA sequence.

prompts: Help me build a one-locus punnett square.
Help me inspect a dna sequence.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Cell & Gene: Biology workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Build a one-locus Punnett square. Reproducible inputs: {"parent_a":"Aa","parent_b":"Aa"}
positive.prompt: Help me build a one-locus punnett square with these supplied values: {"parent_a":"Aa","parent_b":"Aa"}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_biology_punnett_square with the supplied inputs. Returns {"cells":["AA","Aa","Aa","aa"],"distribution":[{"genotype":"AA","probability":0.25},{"genotype":"Aa","probability":0.5},{"genotype":"aa","probability":0.25}],"assumption":"Simple diploid Mendelian one-locus model; no clinical prediction."}. Shows the actual punnett result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Inspect a DNA sequence. Reproducible inputs: {"sequence":"ATGCCGTA"}
positive.prompt: Help me inspect a dna sequence with these supplied values: {"sequence":"ATGCCGTA"}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_biology_dna_complement with the supplied inputs. Returns {"sequence_5_to_3":"ATGCCGTA","complement_3_to_5":"TACGGCAT","reverse_complement_5_to_3":"TACGGCAT","length":8,"gc_percent":50}. Shows the actual sequence result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me compare experimental groups with these supplied values: {"control":[10,12,11],"treated":[21,20,25]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_biology_fold_change with the supplied inputs. Returns {"control_mean":11,"treatment_mean":22,"difference":11,"fold_change":2,"percent_change":100,"note":"Descriptive comparison; no statistical significance or mechanism inferred."}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.
